extDescription.message: Browser-only VPN client for 3x-ui / Xray servers (VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks): local xray-core helper, subscriptions, per-site and per-tab split tunneling.

modeExclude.message: Everything via VPN except the list

popupAddServer.message: Add a server in the settings

toastListUpdated.message: List updated. Reload the tab to apply.

optIntro.message: Browser-only VPN for servers of a 3x-ui panel. A small helper on this computer runs xray-core; Firefox reaches it as a local SOCKS5 proxy.

optKeyLabel.message: Server links (vless://, vmess://, trojan://, ss://), one per line — or a subscription address (https://…)

optStorageHint.message: Links with keys are stored on this computer only, in the helper's folder (owner-only access), not in the Firefox profile.

listHint.message: One domain per line. A domain includes all its subdomains. IPv4 addresses and CIDR subnets are allowed. Lines starting with # are ignored.

optKillSwitch.message: Kill switch: if the tunnel is down, do not let traffic bypass the VPN

optWebrtc.message: Prevent IP leaks through WebRTC while the VPN is on

optDnsHint.message: Names of sites routed via VPN are resolved on the server side: Firefox passes the site name into the tunnel (SOCKS5 with remote DNS).

titleOnTabs.message: XUI — connected, VPN only in marked tabs

titleOnPrivate.message: XUI — connected, VPN only in private windows

titleTabVpn.message: XUI — this tab goes through the VPN

menuOpenLinkVpn.message: Open link in a VPN tab

cmdToggleTabVpn.message: VPN in the current tab on / off

popupTabByContainer.message: Always on: the tab is in the “$1” container.

privNotAllowed.message: The add-on is not allowed in private windows: about:addons → XUI Browser Client → “Run in Private Windows” → Allow.

privAllowed.message: ✓ The add-on is allowed in private windows.

privThisTabDirect.message: This is a normal window: it goes directly. Open a private window to use the VPN.

toastScopeSaved.message: Saved. Reload open tabs to apply.

toastTabVpnOn.message: VPN is on in this tab. Reload the page to apply.

toastTabVpnOff.message: VPN is off in this tab.

scopeAllHint.message: Every tab and window uses the VPN (the site lists below still apply).

scopeTabsHint.message: Only tabs you mark in the toolbar popup, with the hotkey or “Open link in a VPN tab”, plus tabs of the containers chosen below. The VPN stays on the tab whatever site you open in it. Site lists still apply inside those tabs.

scopePrivateHint.message: Only private windows use the VPN; normal windows go directly.

optInheritOpener.message: Tabs opened from a VPN tab also use the VPN

optTabless.message: Requests without a tab (service workers, prefetch):

optContainersHint.message: All tabs of the selected Firefox containers use the VPN.

containersOff.message: Containers are turned off in Firefox (Settings → General → Tabs → Enable Container Tabs).

hotkeysHint.message: Change them: about:addons → ⚙ → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

privNotCovered.message: Private windows are not covered: the add-on is not allowed there, so they bypass the VPN and the kill switch. about:addons → XUI Browser Client → “Run in Private Windows” → Allow.

ipTabVpn.message: This tab uses the VPN address.

ipTabVpnDown.message: This tab is set to use the VPN, but the VPN is not working now.

ipTabDirect.message: This tab goes directly, without the VPN.

ipInfoEnable.message: Show country, provider and address type (asks proxycheck.io about these two addresses)

errIpAnswer.message: unexpected answer of the IP service

geoOffHint.message: Only the site lists above decide.

geoDirectHint.message: Sites hosted in the selected countries open directly, all other countries go via VPN.

geoVpnHint.message: Sites hosted in the selected countries go via VPN, all other countries open directly.

geoDbMissing.message: Country database is not downloaded yet.

geoHint.message: Sites named in the lists above always follow the lists; countries apply to all other sites. To learn a site's country the add-on asks the DNS service chosen above for the site's address. The request (DNS over HTTPS) goes inside the VPN tunnel, so your provider does not see those names; the DNS service sees them coming from your VPN server. Your own server must support DNS over HTTPS (AdGuard Home, AdGuard DNS personal address, etc.). If the country cannot be determined — or the tunnel is down — the routing mode above decides. Only IPv4 is covered. The database (about 8 MB, ip-location-db) is downloaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net when you press “Update database”.

errGeoDownload.message: Could not download the country database: $1

errGeoFormat.message: The downloaded country database is empty or damaged.

statsHint.message: If set, the popup shows a “Statistics” button that opens this page — for example your subscription page in the 3x-ui panel.

errStatsUrl.message: The statistics address must start with http:// or https://

optRemember.message: Keep VPN tabs after a restart

rememberHint.message: Without this, a marked tab that Firefox restores after a restart (or with “Reopen closed tab”) opens without the VPN. To keep the mark with the tab, the add-on needs Firefox's permission “Access recently closed tabs”. It stores one yes/no mark per tab and does not read your closed tabs or history.

rememberOn.message: ✓ Marked tabs keep the VPN after a restart.

rememberOff.message: Not allowed yet: marks last until Firefox is closed.

toastRememberOn.message: VPN tabs will now survive a restart

popupTabNotKept.message: After a Firefox restart this tab will open without the VPN. To keep it: Settings → “Keep VPN tabs after a restart”.

errDnsUrl.message: Enter the address of your DNS server: it must start with https:// (DNS over HTTPS, RFC 8484), for example https://dns.example.com/dns-query

errTunnelDown.message: The tunnel is running, but the server does not answer. Check that the server is reachable and the link is still valid; the exact reason is in the Xray log (Settings).

errNoHelper.message: No connection to the helper on this computer. Install it (scripts/install.sh, macOS and Linux) and restart Firefox. ($1)

errPortsSame.message: The SOCKS5 port and the statistics port must differ.

optNameHint.message: The name applies when a single link is added; otherwise the names come from the links themselves.

toastSubRemoved.message: Servers no longer in the subscription removed: $1

helperHint.message: Install the helper (scripts/install.sh, macOS and Linux) and restart Firefox.

helpHelper.message: A browser cannot speak VLESS, VMess, Trojan or Shadowsocks itself: the add-on needs the helper (xui_host) and xray-core on this computer — see the “Helper” card at the top.

helpServer.message: If the status says the server does not answer: check in 3x-ui that the inbound is enabled, the client has not expired or used up its traffic, and that the link was copied in full. A Reality link must contain pbk, sni and sid.

helpSub.message: Use the ordinary subscription address of the panel (a base64 list of links), not the JSON one. “Refresh” reads it again; this request goes directly, not through the VPN.
